Explain and practise: Number of Tickets Booked

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Number of Tickets Booked

Write a query to display the user id and number of time tickets was booked by each user. Give an alias name as no_of_times. Sort the result based on the user_id.

> **Note:**
> Evaluate only the respective query to get the desired result.
